g.text: reconcileTenantsOnce (60 s, one goroutine per node)
Per-node leg: what this node owes its own units
Registry legs: claimed or guarded, any node may run them
Coordinator leg: one node per namespace

text.tspan: degrade after 3 sweeps with the unit down
teardown what the registry does not assign
lowest sorted live member prunes, evicts, removes from raft
